label: China written across American farmland, and legislation to take it back
description: China seen written across the farmland toward Kansas, Missouri and Nebraska with black stars marking capitals, wheat bent over to the ground, and huge tractors that till the soil but refuse to plant it. Legislation is fought through the House and the Senate in the days ahead to stop China and other foreign powers owning American land, and they have to forfeit their rights.
aliases: I saw China written across Kansas
no foreign power will have a land
the land grab from China

label: The Epstein files are withheld because of blackmail
description: Great corruption seen around the Epstein files, with the reason for their not being fully released given as blackmail: manipulation of governments, of marriages and of wealth. He says the names on the list would shock people and include celebrities as well as politicians, and that the rats do not want to be exposed.
aliases: Epstein files
because of blackmail
the men and women that are on this list

label: Massive granite walls built around Texas
description: Thick marbled granite walls, compared to Greek colosseum stone, seen going up on the eastern and western borders of Texas and along the Mexican border and the Louisiana side, to keep out people moving south from Ohio, Pennsylvania and the northeast. He notes Oklahoma has no such wall.
aliases: massive stone walls on the borders
they didn't want the people coming to Texas
thick concrete walls

label: New York is Mystery Babylon
description: He reports being told specifically that Mystery Babylon is coming and that it is New York, and acknowledges this is controversial because others place Mystery Babylon at Rome. This sits against his own earlier claim that America is not Babylon, and the two are kept apart rather than merged.
aliases: Mystery Babylon is coming
the Lord spoke to me specifically about New York

label: A virus makes people afraid to touch cash
description: Seen about a month before 19 July 2025: people pushing money away because they are afraid to touch it, with a blue currency in Europe identified as the euro, and the virus said to start from China and Europe first. The fear of contaminated notes is what pushes people onto digital currency.
aliases: afraid to touch it because of the virus
I saw a blue currency in Europe
the virus was transferring

label: The crypto wave is artificial, ride it and get out
description: The Lord calls the wave a pig with lipstick and says it will not last forever, with the instruction to ride it and take out what you can. Seen as a wave made of hundred dollar bills that comes down and is done. Certain cryptos are said to double or triple overnight.
aliases: it's a pig with lipstick
a wave that will not last forever
ride the wave and get all you can

label: Portraits of the dead turning white and falling
description: Faces of fallen Iranian soldiers seen on posters, turning pale white, falling down and burning, with the statement that they are in hell. The same image then attaches to a portrait of Donald Trump Jr, whose face turns white and falls in the same way. Given 19 July 2025.
aliases: their faces on these signs
turning pale white and they're falling down
his face is turning white

label: A rock in the sky that China is watching
description: A rock he keeps seeing which he says China knows more about than they tell America, watched through a telescope, and which he associates with Lucifer. He says the people watching it know something is coming.
aliases: they have a telescope and China's really involved
I keep seeing this rock
